openings.claim: A removable strip bridge plus opposed contact stops may retain both plates while permitting gloved service from an unmarked region.
openings.delta: Change the incumbent friction-clamp dependency: use drilled, optionally plier-bent strips bolted through existing slots to carry opposed stops bounding plate translation, with a releasable bridge restraining lift. Cork cushions contacts. All parts must remain outside the working edge and stroke clearance; neither plate nor carriage is altered.
openings.prediction: The nearest rival is the incumbent cork friction clamp. If compliant stop geometry exists, the guided arrangement should keep both plates within 1 mm despite their different magnetic pull checks. Stops should arrest movement at a repeatable boundary; a friction clamp could instead slip progressively under insufficient preload. Neither behavior is established. A bridge requiring awkward screwdriver access could defeat the sixty-second service target.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, use the ruler and loose supplied parts to check slot fit, support, stop spacing permitting less than 1 mm motion, bridge access and an extraction path accessible in gloves without edge contact. If these cannot coexist, reject this configuration. Fabricate only one arrangement within eighty minutes using at most four strips, six bolts and four pads, drilling strips only. Within twenty observation minutes, run three twenty-stroke checks: original plate, spare, spare final. Measure displacement from carriage marks and inspect stop contact or deformation. Perform three timed removal/return checks, with final spare removal in thick gloves. Loosen the bridge with the supplied screwdriver and handle only unmarked regions. These checks assess this arrangement; they do not establish comparative superiority over an untested rival.
assumptions: Slots accept M4 bolts and allow all stops to anchor without rail detachment.
Strip dimensions, stiffness and plier bendability permit compliant stops and bridge.
Available support and glove access permit extraction and repeatable reseating.

assessment: Defeat conditions include displacement above 1 mm, service above sixty seconds, stop deformation, working-edge contact, clearance intrusion, or exceeding supplied resources/time. Unknown geometry and stroke forces leave feasibility unresolved. This is a bounded probe, not deployment.

lineage.reason: Retains bolted strip serviceability while adding contact boundaries to reduce dependence on friction preload.
